name: Qdrant
label: Qdrant — points REST (:6333)
description: Official Qdrant REST at http://localhost:6333. Points upsert/query/get/scroll/delete. Auth header api-key from secret api_key (empty prefix). Customer owns the cluster. Never log api_key or vectors. Docs: https://qdrant.tech/documentation/ · OpenAPI https://api.qdrant.tech
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"operation":"collection.search","collection":"docs","query":[0.1,0.2],"limit":10}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: collection.upsert | collection.search | collection.get | collection.scroll | collection.delete. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP. Do not put api_key here. Example: 'collection.search'.

schema.label: points
schema.description: Upsert: {id, vector, payload?}[]. Delete: official id list field `points`.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Official Query API `query` (dense vector, id, or formula). Prefer this over legacy /points/search.

schema.label: ids
schema.description: Point ids for collection.get (official body ids).

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Scroll offset (id or number as official).

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Qdrant filter. Delete requires points or filter.

schema.label: with_vector
schema.description: Include vectors (default false). Do not log vectors.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: collection.upsert | collection.search | collection.get | collection.scroll | collection.delete.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Qdrant API key. Sent as header api-key. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Cloud: cluster API keys.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
